items.title: Chicago Mayor Demands Data Center Moratorium
items.summary: Bloomberg's Miranda Davis joins Emily Graffeo on "Real Yield." Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson is pushing for a temporary moratorium on data centers, and signed an executive order on Tuesday to create new rules for any future developments. (Source: Bloomberg)
